name: Signable
summary: UK-based electronic signature software for sending, signing and tracking documents, priced by the envelope with unlimited users and templates, UK-hosted data and an API on higher plans.
best_for: UK and European small and mid-sized businesses that send contracts, agreements and forms for signature and want to pay by the document rather than by the user, with UK-hosted data
skip_if: you need the API, bulk sending or Qualified Electronic Signatures on a small budget, since those start on Business; or you want a full contract lifecycle tool with negotiation and contract management rather than signing
honest_knock: Business and Enterprise prices are only 'from' figures and go through sales, and the overage fee for envelopes beyond your allowance is not published. Unused envelopes on a paid plan are lost at the end of the billing period. The API, bulk send and Qualified Electronic Signatures all start on Business, from £100 a month, not on Essentials.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-20 on signable.com/plans, prices in pounds plus VAT; the EU page signable.com/plans-eu was read on 2026-10-15) Signable prices by the envelope, not by the user: every plan has unlimited users and unlimited templates. An envelope is one package of one or more documents sent together for signing. Pay As You Go starts from £2.60 an envelope, bought upfront in bundles. Essentials is £40 a month billed annually and includes 300 envelopes a year, all available at the start of the plan, and adds your own branding. Business is from £100 a month billed annually, from 1,200 envelopes, and adds API access, Teams, bulk send, concierge onboarding, IP allowlisting and Qualified Electronic Signatures; it goes through 'Talk to Sales'. Enterprise is from £250 a month billed annually, from 5,000 envelopes, and adds Single Sign-On, an account manager, free unlimited training, template and branding set-up and premium support. On the EU page Essentials is €560 a year and Pay As You Go starts from €3.03. Unused envelopes on a paid plan do not roll over to the next billing period. Go past your allowance without buying another bundle and you pay an overage fee per extra envelope; the page does not publish that fee, and extra bundles are only sold on Business and Enterprise. The terms say prices exclude VAT and other taxes.

schema_offer.description: Essentials, billed annually, plus VAT; 300 envelopes a year, available upfront; Pay As You Go from £2.60 an envelope in prepaid bundles; Business from £100 a month (from 1,200 envelopes) and Enterprise from £250 a month (from 5,000 envelopes), both billed annually through sales; the EU page shows Essentials at €560 a year and Pay As You Go from €3.03. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-20.

compare_with.name: Oneflow
compare_with.why: Oneflow is in our dossiers too, but it sells a different thing: a full contract platform for creating, negotiating, e-signing and archiving contracts, priced per user at €50 a month billed annually with a five-user minimum when we read it on 5 October 2026. Signable charges by the envelope with unlimited users, from £40 a month billed annually for 300 envelopes a year. If you only need documents signed, Signable is the lighter and cheaper fit; if contracts are negotiated and managed in the tool, look at Oneflow.
